description: Reference data (an experimental measurement or an established correlation, e.g. skin-friction coefficient Cf or lift/drag vs. angle of attack) for one NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource case, as published by the case's own data file. Only available for a subset of cases — call tmr_cases first and check "reference_data: true" — because most TMR case directories hold dozens of individual turbulence-model CFD result files alongside the reference data, and this tool only serves files the case page itself unambiguously labels as the reference/experimental data.
name: tmr_reference_data
title: Tmr Reference Data
